generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Conditional bids will not be accepted. The bid is of two cover system.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Aspiring Bidders or Contractors who have not obtained the user ID and Password for participating in e Procurement, may now obtain the same from the website www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in .Corrigendum or modification or corrections, if any, will be published in the website only. For any clarification on e Procurement, can be contacted the office of the Executive Engineer (O and M) Gerusoppa, KPCL, Gerusoppa 581 384, Honavar Tq, Uttara Kannada Dist, Karnataka or HELPDESK 08046010000 or 08068948777.

The bidder shall quote in Indian Rupees only. After evaluation of Technical Bid and whose offer meet the PQR and technical specification of the bid or bid in complete manner will be accepted and only such bidders Financial bid will be opened.
The bid of the bidders whose GST status is inactive at the time of evaluation will be rejected.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have sufficient experience in executing similar work of HT or LT Power line erection or restoration and In proof of experience,Work Order with its Work done certificate for at least one single Work Order executed in last five financial years (ie.2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26) in the name of bidder with the Contract value not less than Rs.2,09,123.00 issued by the competent authorities shall be furnished.The value of the completed works shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the FY in which the tenders are invited.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Workdone certificate with corresponding work order copy

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should be a Class-1 or above Electrical Contractor license As a proof, a copy of Valid Electrical License issued by Govt. of Karnataka/Company registration Certificate shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Class I or above valid Electrical licence

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 4.18 Lakhs in any two financial years of last five financial years (ie. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). In proof, the agency should furnish annual turnover certificate/Profit & Loss Statement issued by Chartered accountant. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the FY in which the tenders are invited
